messages.subject: Project Lyra — licence mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (tracked). The headline changes:
- Clause 11.3: liability capped at the £6m upfront fee (deletes your carve-outs);
- Clause 4.1: hard diligence long-stop of 31 December 2027 for first Phase II, with conversion to non-exclusive if missed;
- Clause 3.7: audit cost-shifting threshold reduced from 5% to 3%.

The rest is light. Dr Brandt is keen to sign this month if we can resolve clause 11.

Oliver

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena — Calderbrook's v2 is in. As expected they've gone to a £6m hard cap and stripped the carve-outs, added the 31 Dec 2027 long-stop, and dropped the audit threshold to 3%. I'll prepare our counter (v3): reinstate uncapped IP warranties + confidentiality, general cap at greater of £10m / 12 months, push the long-stop to mid-2028, and revert audit to 5%. Will circulate internally before it goes back.

James

--
James Osei | Senior Associate, Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
